verdicts.reason: Both leave the geometric background unscaled: it stops about 60px short of the square canvas, so blank white bands run across the top and bottom. In A, the white frame is shoved up and out of register. Its top edge sits above where the background starts, its bottom edge cuts across the pink band well above the background's end, and the text card sits high and off-centre inside it. B keeps the frame and card centred and in proportion with the original's composition and type hierarchy, so it is the less broken resize. Its empty top and bottom bands are still a fail that must be fixed before shipping.
